Author: bodyboarder2528
Description: Device support for the AJAZZ AKP153E (rev. 2) using only signed code (Node + PowerShell + Windows' hid.dll), because Smart App Control blocks the original opendeck-akp153 plugin's exe. Adds animated GIF keys, a whole-deck screensaver, homelab alert flashes and night dimming.
Name: Jarvis AKP153E

Actions.Name: Animated GIF
Actions.Tooltip: Plays a GIF on this key (AKP153E only). Set the file in the settings.
